I am a PhD candidate in Social Policy at the London School of Economics, supervised by Stephen Jenkins and Francisco Ferreira. My research lies at the intersection of social policy, welfare analysis, development economics, and social economics, with a particular emphasis on methodological work.

**I am currently on the 2026–27 academic job market.**

## Research Interests

Poverty and inequality · Labour economics · Applied econometrics · Computational social science
